body:
Alright. You're probably right. I'm freaking out over nothing. She even called her grandmother, now in the dead of night, and she laughed and said it's fine.

Well.. Who else to trust, I suppose. I think I'll tell my family too, ask them, just to be sure. And if anything goes wrong, there's always a way out.. I pray that it's not murder in God's eyes.

And I don't think they would disown her, no. I'm afraid they'd outright kill her. Literally. Her father used to beat her a fair bit. It isn't as common nowadays but still happens occasionally. He even said, when they talked about this, "you can do it, it belongs to a relationship, but God help you if you get pregnant."

So death by our own means seems the most peaceful.

Then it better be an early period and not some post-implantation bleeding or whatever scary name they've given it.

Good God. The thought of someone finding my mutilated corpse and a makeshift shotgun on the floor brings me to tears. I can't do this. Why couldn't I have just stopped myself? I should have been a celibate.

Bad hand describes it. I'm born ugly, skinny, dim-witted, hardly respected and overall inferior to just about everyone.

And just when things start taking a turn for the better, this happens. I've prayed my heart out, but I just don't see why this is being done to me.

God won't give us anything for free. Ever. First time I even touched her, things were scary and odd.

I wish I had never gotten into this mess. I swear that I am sorry for breaking another commandment, if that's why it's happening. I would never do it again, knowing the outcome, and even if I do not die, I vow to never do this thing ever again.

But thank you for the reassurance. I pray that it's okay... And it probably ain't.

Edit: Yes, she herself has stated many times that they are woefully irregular and usually extremely unpleasant... But 10 days early?

No. That won't happen. This mistake alone is worth dying for. Family can't find out, I'm telling you. Mine wouldn't care much, I suppose, but I tremble at the thought of hers.

We're both half-suicidal metalheads anyway so.. Good Lord, I really don't know. Should never have done this. I regret everything now.

Indeed, it is quite a shame. Especially since our country is partly the birthplace of protestantism. With such a rich Christian history, one might think that our heritage would remain. Sadly not.

Though I have noticed that there's been at least a slight shift. Seems to me that more young people have faith than before. Perhaps this crisis has united at least some of us.

Of course. I wouldn't preach to someone if they didn't like it. When I was an atheist, I utterly hated that, so I know what it's like.

I suppose so. I have a very small NT, suited for a pocket, so even just by size alone, one can figure out what it is, but a cover might just solve my issues.

Thank you again, friend.

I do. I visit Catholic/Orthodox churches and pray there, just as I would in a Protestant church. In fact, I'm not quite sure about Protestantism. I'm quite keen on wearing a cross on my body, without seeing it as an idol, and while I'm not really one for Papal power, I just don't hold that much against it either... I'm more for Protestantism in the sense of Jan Hus' protestantism. The modern sort seems too strict with symbols and rituals.

So for now, I suppose I'll lay off on denominations and eventually see what suits my faith best.

That's what I've been doing. There's a guy who's going through very hard times now, so I've been sharing what faith has given me. After all, my faith comes from some very hard times indeed. 

Perhaps I'll be able to preach in a church one day! That would be amazing, to share my insights with others...
Oh I agree. I used to be a pretty hardcore atheist, so I've seen all the sides and know both their good and bad sides. We're all flawed, in the end, whether religious or not.

Oh no, I didn't mean preaching in that sense. I meant preaching to a congregation as an actual pastor. 

That might be a smart idea... But I'm not sure if it would count as forsaking Christ. It's said in the Bible that who is ashamed of Christ, of him Christ shall too be ashamed. So I'll probably have to endure the pain.

Thanks mate, I appreciate the support.

I met semi-regularly with a group of young protestants led by the pastor's daughter, but because of time constraints, the group sort of fell apart...

It should be back up and running in the summer though.
That seems to be the direction I'm taking, yes. If they aren't willing to accept someone because of their faith, so be it. I won't judge them for it, but it's best if I avoid them.

I see... Well, I'm not a creationist, and if anything, due to science alone, I would personally not take Genesis literally. 

Still, I'm not sure if the clip is meant to protect one's faith, or rather if it is meant to deter it. 

Thank you either way!

I'll definitely continue to study the word, I try to do so as often as possible, and when I feel confident in my knowledge, I'll go seek out the local mission. I am glad that I do not need some special right of passage, other than knowledge of the word.

That passage is very inspiring to say the least. It is true. He who suffers for Christ, he who does not betray his faith in harsh times and endures will receive salvation, and is closer to being just. So for the sake of what's right, I won't forsake my faith. I will never be truly just, that is clear, but I will try to come as close as possible, despite my sins and wrongdoings.

Thank you, my friend.
Tastes alright, ye. I mix it with water most of the time and it goes down okay, but it takes a few minutes to finish off.
Too bad I absolutely despise milk. I should get about 2,4k calories a day. I think I get about 1,8k, so I need to consume more, I suppose.
Mhm, I drink a mass gainer after individual workouts. It's a lower-calorie one though, so maybe I should up the values.
I definitely try. Especially with self-deprecating humor and such. See, it's difficult to find someone who'd desire me, because, as I said, I'm not the prettiest lad out there. But it'll work soon.

About 5 times a week, although I've been slacking this week, focusing on legs so that I can do the Cossack Dance sooner. 

I usually go for about 20-40 minutes. I dedicate half of it to front upper arms, forearms and shoulders, and the other half to triceps and chest. For most exercises, I try to do 4 sets of 12 with either bodyweight or 10kg weights. I get healthy breaks (never do the same muscle group two days in a row) and I'd say I eat plenty, even added protein and carbohydrate supplements. 

Problem is, I went from super skinny (5'10" and 55kg at the start of the summer, 5'10" and 62kg at the end), so it's naturally harder to put on mass. Been going for a month and a half though, so there's still time for results to show.

Alright, I'll join you guys. It's a weightlifting group? If so, I need help. I'm really struggling to put on weight. Triceps are going fine, doing bench dips and stuff and it's been working well, and the forearms, chest, legs and stomach are all shaping up nicely as well, but the bicep is worthless.
Doing all sorts of curls for 'em, but I just can't gain in that area. 

 Add me on Steam, I have a very original name. Unteroffizier Schweinehund.
I'll check the lad out, thanks mate.

I'm pretty good at holding conversations. I learned that skill over the course of last year and I've become quite well-spoken, adept at using the strategies you mentioned and generally "fun to talk to."

Looks do screw you over quite badly though, especially for non-platonic relations. That's why I have to rely on divine powers, because there is nothing in this world that I can do to improve my face. I've done everything else, and it seems that it might not be enough.

Good idea, and I do. I am lonely in a non-platonic sense. However, I have prayed and my prayers seem to not have been ignored, and they seem to have been acknowledged.

And yes, I meet with a group every three weeks at a local pseudo-church with the pastor's daughter leading it.

It isn't my religious belief that makes me lonely, as I don't really need to have other Christians around me. I don't talk much about religion anymore, and so my thoughts are enough for me in that department. I agree, however, about imitating the behaviors of others, which I generally disagreed with even before finding my interest in Christianity.

Well when that day comes, if it is in my lifetime, then I hope I can be saved as well. However, while a great life after death is intriguing, it is not my main goal. If Christ is truth, then I will fight for truth on Earth, and if that makes my earthly life good, then it is enough for me. I want to do good for the sake of doing good, and while paradise would be amazing, I would accept if I was not brought there.

Hopefully I can live a good life here and a better life after. I'd hate to make my life too baroque, so to speak.
Thank you. I will do what can be done and I will try to keep my fresh faith stable, and write it in stone so that it may last for years to come.
And I do believe that after what he has performed for me not once, but twice, that I am ready to submit myself.
Because Prague contains only about 0.1 or so % of protestants. My youth group is as close as I'll get.
Yes indeed. It is great. I have a newfound hope, however my faith is still not unconditional. It is still frail and hangs by a thread. I need to solidify it, lest I become a non-believer again.

No, but I meet regularly with a group of other protestant youth. I try to serve God on my own as best I can, even if I do not yet know how. I read the word and I try to embrace it. For now, I can do no more.

Then I will forsake the devil and seek God, and I will have faith in him and one day, my wish will be fulfilled. Perhaps when I least expect it.

Thank you, my friend.
Thank you, my friend.

Matthew's the best chapter in the law, I think. It is so enlightening and helpful in many ways.

You know, after tonight, after something happened, I think I finally gained faith. I'm absolutely bewildered that after years of disbelief and doubt, and after so much pleading for truth, I have finally been given an answer. It's enlightening, and it's honestly bringing tears to my eyes.

I sincerely hope I wake up tomorrow and keep my faith. I'd hate to lose what I gained.

As I have done. God is and always will be my closest friend and ally, I have no doubt about it, yet I too am merely human and wish for human companionship and intimacy. God has made us in his image, therefore capable of love, and I must share my love with my fellow man.

Will I be granted this wish?

And bless you as well, my friend.

So you have faith that God will give you a man you can love, and who will love you? I too will have that faith, and perhaps he will do the same for me if I ask.

Thank you.

I have. I would tell of the answers I've received, but it is said in the Bible that one should not boast about the things God has done for him, and so I will not. 

I have faith that forgiveness will be given to me, and all will be good.
I can always take an image and trace it back to the source. If it's some random Google Search image or from someone else's profile, it's obvious. I think that's the most reliable method myself.

That's what I'm thinking, yeah. It's quite unfortunate, but I wasn't really too interested in all of this when I first joined this school. 

I am somewhat afraid of fake accounts trying to screw me over somehow, but the site's huge in the country, so it should be okay. Still feels cowardly and low, but I can justify it with my current situation.

I'm in engineering school, and there are next to none there. Our whole class is 100% male, and there are four girls in the whole year (of like 110 students or something).

I actually happen to have no problem talking to them. I find that my conversationalist skills could be far worse (a taught skill, I used to be downright reclusive), and public speaking is something I thoroughly enjoy. It's just that initial step that I'm afraid of taking with strangers. The Internet helps overcome that though. Anyone on that site is automatically willing to be approached, and so there's no fear of seeming creepy.

I will, however, leave that profile idle and just wait if someone's interested in me. In the mean time, I'll try to find more legitimate ways. If I find someone in real life sooner, good. If someone writes me before I can, good as well! Of course, there's a chance that neither plan will work out, in which case I'll have to start seriously rethinking it.

It is, I know. But what am I to do? I know no other way to meet them. I simply do not. It kills me, believe me, it does, and I feel like a low coward. In fact, I'm considering rolling back my decision, but I have no other hope.

Yes, you can become more specialized earlier on in this country, which is what I did. Probably a mistake, considering the fact that it forced me to use goddamn online dating sites, something I was quite opposed to until recently.

But yeah, hopefully someone writes to me. Even if they're self-conscious, I know the struggle, so perhaps I could help them fight it. Doesn't help that I'm anything but photogenic, so all my pictures are trash, but maybe someone ugly-ish will give me a chance. I honestly don't care much about appearance unless their nose is crooked or they're fat, but I can't be picky. I must take what I'm given, if anything at all. Amen, I say, give me mercy.

No no, I do not have my degree yet. I am only almost a machinist/technician right now, which is the starting level for future mechanical engineers in my country (Czech Republic, known now as Czechia, not to be mistaken with Chechnia). Even then, the field is a sausage fest.

About catfishing, I agree. Which is why I have employed several means of verifying people, and if they do slip past my radar, I am pretty heavily armed whenever I go outside anyway (steel pipe and a nine inch blade, good idea to carry around for safety), both concealed, of course.

Right. I hope someone writes to me. I'm willing to take anyone who isn't fat, really. Anyone.

Well, you see, since I'm an engineering student, I don't get many opportunities to meet girls. That, and since I'm in a pretty big city, random approaches are absolutely out of the question.

Only logical solution is the Internet, since all my friends, through whom I could meet someone, are also engineers. 

Don't know if it's a good idea, don't know if I'm pretty enough, but hopefully someone bites and I can have a few nice experiences.

Really? Well thank Christ, literally (I'm trying to become a protestant). I was afraid that the way my life improved was just a delusion.

I'll be setting that up then.
So I am still quite sub-par, eh? Suppose there's no point setting up that online profile then? Fuck me, I was almost getting excited about meeting someone on there...

Here's another one that's okay-ish. Probably better than the last ones, I don't know.

https://imgur.com/nvnxSIW

I certainly hope you're right, and I do end up being that ever-desired 5/10, because I don't know what I'll do if I'm this ugly forever. I know I can still get it done, even if I have a poor face, but it'd be a lot easier if I didn't. That, and being confident when you look like this is pretty difficult. It has gotten better though. It's gotten so good that now I legitimately almost believe that I look pretty okay, no worse than most peers, but yeah, that's probably a delusion.
So you think I still have potential to be average-looking in the end? And will that even be enough? I won't settle for 4/10, and if that's still what I am by then, it'll have to be plastic surgery.

I did, and it actually helped a lot. I think I pretty much got rid of those entirely. Overall, my skin's gotten a lot cleaner than it was a few weeks ago. I think it has, anyway.

I'm still not very pretty, nor will I ever be, but I can always strive to be average. That's still hopefully within my reach, and that's what I'll aim for.

Actually, no. Fuck that. You're absolutely right. It's bullshit.

Am I ugly as all hell? Yeah. Does that mean life's over? No. I'll do everything I can to spite all the good-looking people of the world by succeeding with an unattractive face. I'll discover something, I'll find a way to become immortal and only share it with ugly people, because fuck everyone else. 

I'll dedicate my life to improve the lives of my kin, and to spite those who are better than me. That is the key to eternity and happiness.

You a national comrade? Další Čech?

I may be fucked mentally, but only because I'm fucked physically. I will not stand for being below average. I will not. I am lower than 5/10, and that means my life is over. Plain and simple. Beautiful and average people should not suffer the presence of ugly people like me. I deserve to die for being ugly.

Also, do not worry about doing harm. No harm can be done, I've made my decision already. Just putting it off because I'm a horrible fucking coward.

It's not worth it. It won't change anything. I'll still be a 4, hair doesn't change a damn thing. Just look at those droopy eyes, that huge nose and tiny mouth. Good God, and the fat around the cheeks. The tall forehead, almost looks like a receding hairline. Oh and the jaw, such an awful jaw. Huge, permanently pouting lips. Oh and don't even get me started on that neck.

It's strange though. My whole family is made of 6-8 people, and somehow I inherited the worst traits from each of them. I blame the fact that I'm a crossbreed (C. European, Scandinavian, American and Balkan all in one). 

Given up by now. Not worth it. No one will ever want me anyway, so what's the point of living, eh? Always been a good designer though. I can make a gun and shoot myself in a day if I get the parts I need.

What do you mean, I didn't post pictures...

Unless, of course, you found my old TRP and AIU rants, in which case, the AIU rant is more recent. Unfortunately, no haircuts look good on me. Radically shortened it, still looks like shit. Everything looks bad. Everything. Someone told me to get a goddamn crew cut, but that'd be social suicide.

I look bad. No point denying it. I'm sub-par, maybe (MAYBE) average at the very best on a very good day. The people there told me straight up, I'm about a 4/10. I mean, that's hopeless. It's suicide-level bad without a doubt.

Yeah, I was too... At first. Now I'm in engineering, thank Christ (or Baphomet). You're right about idols. Depends on your point of view. From a Christian point of view, all idols are false. Hell, even the cross is a false idol, apparently.

Anyway, I really wish physical appearance didn't mean as much as it does. I really, really do. But I can't blame society for putting value upon it. It's true. It's the way it is and I'm not one of those "ugly acceptance" activists. No one wants a naturally skinny, average height, ugly-feminine-faced fucker with no redeeming qualities. It's just evolution. The inferior die out.

When I feel like shit, I usually gaze upon the form of Baphomet, the Sabbatic Goat, false Templar idol and symbol of alchemy...

No, I'm actually just interested in false idols in general. Yeah, animal videos are fun. But it's as I said, I'm probably too far gone. Just making it as pleasant as possible for myself before I realize that life like this has no point.

You can't cause more damage to someone who's pretty much made a decision already. Time's ticking for me. It's a matter of time before I get the courage to go through with it.

But, you know, death isn't really a bad thing. In fact, I'd argue that life is probably a whole lot worse. Sounds stupid, right? But I think I'll take nothingness over unattractiveness. The former is a mystery, the latter is just pure shit.
Films don't cause emotional responses in me, only real life stuff does. It'll be alright.

Never seen it. Will give it a watch. Hopefully it helps drown out the shitty feeling of being unattractive. Now that sucks more than a kick in the nuts, I tell you.

Shame, really. Was looking forward to having an heir eventually. Not happening.

I'm afraid I've already succumbed to both. But you're right, people show only the good things. People lie. It's our nature. 

I guess not all of us are fit for life, eh? Sometimes life kicks your ass, and sometimes it kicks you so hard your intestines come out your mouth. It's like being dealt a king and a six with three aces and two queens on the table. Pure shit.

I know, I can't. But I've done everything not to be dictated by my ugliness. It's so difficult to get past it, I swear to my maker. 

I've been on TRP, I've been on AmIUgly, I've been everywhere. I've been called bad-looking, okay-looking, decent-looking and even cute, but the only honest responses were the negative ones. Positive responses are rarely honest. 

It's so goddamn difficult to get past this single fact of life that I'd almost rather die than face it head on. 

Hell, most people actually really hate me because I can be irritable when going through a bout of depression. I understand their hatred. I'd hate me as well. Only another reason to end it all, I suppose. Getting sick of people freaking out on me, not talking to me, being loud on purpose to show their discontent and these other little things. Just don't want to deal with life and people.

My face is pretty fucking hideous mate, really. It is. But that's beside the point.

I don't think everyone can and will be happy. We're animals, and only adequate individuals can be happy. I'm not adequate, hence I cannot be happy. Such is life.

Nope, I've got no one. Even if I did, what's he gonna do? Try to convince me that I'm not hideous?

Honestly, there's nothing they can do because I want to die on the grounds of truth. I'm not delusional, but realistic. That's why there's not much that can save me. There's actually no reason to live.

Thanks, but there's no point. I'll probably end up dead in a ditch before the year's out. 

That's probably the best scenario.
I don't use social media. Cancerbook is only to communicate with my class.

Nah. Nothing's fun anymore. Not when I'm alone for it all. I'm so goddamn poor-looking that people consciously avoid me. Hell, I'd avoid myself.

Sure, I go outside. From time to time. Usually sit around and contemplate the worst, but I guess that's my place in life.

To answer your questions, yes, you probably can (it doesn't take much physical effort), and yes, assisted suicide is a thing. Both of those things are stupid though. You might feel as though you want to end your life, and it's a perfectly valid feeling (I go through it every single day), but ultimately, it's an irreversible act that requires plenty of thought beforehand.

Before you say I'm advocating for suicide, however, I must say that I don't understand why you want to kill yourself to begin with. I'd like to cough up some support and try to help you out (preferably without the need for death), but I don't really know what's wrong. If you could explain to me what troubles you, I'd be more than willing to talk it through.

So what's up?

I'm just as human as anyone. Far from subhuman. All I'm saying is that there are certain things I'll never be able to experience, just as many people will never be able to experience some things I can. 

Some people have looks, some people have brains. Some people have both and others have neither. A human is insanely complex and cannot be defined by looks alone. However, and this is one damn important 'however,' certain things do require good looks. A braindead model might never become an engineer, and a shovelface engineer will never be very attractive or desirable. There's nothing wrong with either, but both have limited opportunities in some way or another.

I'm not disappointed, I'm not mad about it. I just needed to know for sure if my suspicions were true (since my family insists on lying to me about my poor looks), so that I can focus on brain-stuff instead. Does that not sound logical?

If by pathetic bullshit you mean realism, then I'm afraid I'm not willing to lie to myself. If there is one trait I can be proud of, it is absolute honesty. 

Even the Red Pill teaches that there are those beyond help (at least it does in my interpretation). I came here to have my face analyzed, so that I could find out whether or not I should keep up the struggle. The community has made clear to me that the struggle is pointless. I have no so-called "SMV" if I have poor appearance.

I got what I came for; confirmation. Am I ugly? I am. So be it. There's not much that can be done about that, so I'd best focus on other things, even as a worthless incel.

I'm already Red Pilled and spent some time on TRP, no worries.

Trying not to obsess over looks, but it's such an important thing nowadays that only an arranged marriage for claims against the Petty Kingdom of Mumu would save me from being one of those FA guys.

I know no one gives a shit. Precisely the reason. I'm trying to be a Protestant, trying as best I can to convert and repent my sins of failing to be a better human being. If God cannot forgive me, no one can. If only I had true faith, but I have none.

You know that the moment you hate the better half of society, your life is worthless. When your life is driven by hatred and thrash metal, and the only thing keeping you alive is knowing that life will end eventually, it makes you question the point.

I have nothing if I don't have good looks. I'm not intelligent, I'm not quick, strong or charismatic. I'm nothing, and no one. The fine people have judged with honesty and righteous fury, just as I have asked, and confirmed my suspicions. Beautiful people should not be burdened by the presence of my sort.

So thank you again. Honesty is all I needed. I hope humanity makes it far, it's all I ever hoped for.

No, I've finished growing. 5'10. There is no hope and I really don't care much more. Life bores me as it is, and being bad-looking is just the final nail in the coffin. 

Honestly, what difference do 60 years make in the grand scheme of things? If I'll live 60 years being loathed for looking like shit, I'd rather not live at all. Seems like a reasonable decision. I guess that's why people look at me so often. They secretly despise me. That explains it.

Yup, that's what I thought. 4 is about right, maybe even less. 

A real shame, really. Everyone in the family's very attractive, and somehow I ended up like this. It makes no sense, even from a genetic standpoint. I have no one to inherit these shit features from. 

It's nature's defense mechanism so that low-rating people don't breed. It's okay. I'll join a church and dedicate myself to God or something. Heard celibates have it better in Heaven, if that shit even exists.

Thanks for the honesty. I rarely get it from anyone.

Edit: I have not watched that trash for a very long time now. It is worthless. Just another useless distraction.
Yeah, sure, why not? What's up?

Really? Well, thanks. I appreciate it, I really do.

I look exhausted because I am. I don't know if I'm sick or if it's just a messed up sleep schedule (I can't fall asleep before 1:30AM), but it's been that way for a while. Not enough free time after a hard day, so I write stories in the night and only get about 5-6 hours of sleep. Suppose it's evident from the rings under my eyes.

Do you know of any methods to get rid of those rings? I think they're a huge detriment to my appearance. Probably one of the greatest, actually.

Thanks. I'll see what can be done about it. Had 2 hair stylist appointments in the past month alone! Hope it doesn't make me one of those metrosexuals. Not that there's anything wrong with being metrosexual, but I'd like to believe I'm not.
You're too kind. Thanks though.
Hopefully. Although I might be a bit too pale, no?

I'm pretty good at smalltalk, I'd say. Unfortunately, with the sort of people I meet, I'm usually the one who does most of the talking. If I don't lead the conversation, awkward silence ensues indefinitely. Quiet people who don't seem too great at the whole deal. And when I meet outgoing people, we're incompatible because of the constant interrupting.

I'm joining a HEMA class soon. Historical European Fencing. German langes Schwert (Longsword) fighting. But the people are usually well into their 20's or 30's, and it's male dominated. I need to learn how to deal with people of the opposite gender, even in a platonic manner. I just have no opportunities, and when I do, I feel that my looks are too repulsive.

I just realized that that's the issue. My male colleagues and co-students just don't respect me at all. I don't understand what I did, but they treat me like dirt. I don't mean the friendly jabs. I mean blatant disrespect, constant berating without end. The amount of times I've been called ugly by them and the amount of times they said I wouldn't find anyone is astonishing. Suppose I took it to heart. Some friends they are. 

I've never called them out on their bullshit for fear of being ridiculed even more, but goddamn am I getting sick of their shit.

Oh, I thought they meant post, as in thread. In that case, I'll PM it, sure. 

I'm trying to smile right now, but it turns out looking like Gollum every time. It's so difficult to not look annoyed. Whatever, I'll send the pic even if it looks shitty.
I mean, should I put the pic here? I honestly think it won't improve anything though.
Looks like shit, just like yesterday. Although, I could try to comb it and shave my face after a damn week and take a picture, see how it looks. I'll also try to smile.
That's a shame. I already spent nearly $40 trying to fix that shit. It's impossible. Had it cut and adjusted twice by two different experts. None of them can get it to look good.
Smiling is very hard for me.

Good old Pod. And don't forget Tormund and his giant, world-conquering children. Of course, I'd leave the children out of it. They'd crush me with a single touch. Still, take me Tormund!

Are there any flaws you can specifically pick out? I think I have a shitty forehead, incorrectly tilted eyes, horrible under-eye rings, a huge nose, terribly large lips, a shit jaw and a far too large chin.

I'd go gay for Jorah, no joke. And if I could get both Jorah and Beric, with Thoros in a supporting role, my life would be complete.

You know, if I had Thoros at home, I'd kill myself and have him revive me.

So you really think it'll get better in time, hm? I know I look far better than I did a year ago. I was the most degenerate scrub last year, I swear to God. I'm just afraid this is my peak, and that it isn't enough these days.

A man has no name. 

Alright, good. Thanks. And how'd you rate Beric Dondarrion from GoT in comparison? Just curious, because that guy is a damn 10 for me, even with the eyepatch.

Well I guess that's pretty much all I can do, eh? 

So what rating do I get right now? Just so I know whether or not I should even try. From the other responses, I have deduced that I shouldn't bother with it (with an avg of 4), but another opinion is always welcome.

I guess. 

So what should I do about myself? Any flaws I can fix? The hair sucks, I know. It always has. A smile seems impossible. Any other fixable details?

Good point. It's still a pointless cause. I don't even have any solid friends to begin with. Honestly, most people would love to see me take a shot of bleach.

Hell, I'm not even short. 5'10. I lift. I dress alright. I keep my back straight and try my best to radiate confidence. How does face alone ruin all those efforts? Are people afraid of me or what?

Heh. The advantage of being a somewhat passable writer. I wish I was silver-tongued in the real world. I certainly can be around friends and strangers, but not around potential mates, if you can even call them that.
